name: example_trend_breakout
hypothesis: Donchian breakouts taken only in the direction of the higher-timeframe trend and only when ADX says the market is trending follow through; a wide ATR stop keeps cost_r low, and a break-even move plus ATR trail protects open profit.

name: example_range_reversion
hypothesis: When ADX is low (no trend) and price is stretched outside its Bollinger band, it tends to snap back toward the mean within a few hours, especially when the stretch was not driven by aggressive one-sided taker flow.
